goal.title: Built set format
criteria: A built set holds HP, types, attack costs, damage, retreat and stage once per print, apart from its English wording.
Writing the same set twice produces identical bytes, and changing one print's text changes only that print's lines.
Adding a second language's wording to one print leaves that print's English wording and language-independent facts byte for byte unchanged.
A set with a print lacking an English name or English text for one of its attacks, abilities or effect is reported as invalid.
A built print converts into the same card definition the playmat uses today, for Pokémon, Trainers and Energy.

scope.rule: Change only the files that belong to this item; change nothing that belongs to another task.

verdicts.evidence: internal/cardset/format.go:62-81: Print holds HP, Types, Stage, Attacks (AttackCore with Cost and Damage), Retreat once per print; wording lives separately in Print.Text (line 80, PrintText at lines 102-108). AttackCore at lines 84-87 holds only cost and damage.

format.go:11-13 and 143-173: fixed struct key order, json map keys sorted by encoding/json, prints sorted by SortPrints (lines 207-229), two-space indent, trailing newline. format_test.go:96-113 checks identical bytes for two writes; format_test.go:147-171 changes one print's English effect and asserts exactly one changed line of the same line count.

format_test.go:173-218 adds a 'fr' block to tst-002 and asserts the English PrintText and the core (Text stripped, then marshalled) are unchanged, and that every original line of the file survives in order. Format keeps language blocks in the map under Print.Text (format.go:80), so a new language adds a block without touching the others.

format.go:262-301 (Print.Validate) rejects a print with no English text or a blank English name, and any language's blank attack or ability name (lines 281-290). It also rejects non-English effect text where English has none (lines 296-310). But it does not reject a print whose English text lacks an effect where one is required: a Trainer or Energy print with an empty English Effect (Print.Text['en'].Effect) passes, and so does an English ability with a name but no effect. Nothing in format_test.go:220-261 tests a missing English effect for a Trainer, Energy or ability. Attack effect text is legitimately optional, so only the Trainer/Energy effect and ability effect gaps are relevant. The English effect requirement is a gap.

card.go:16-55 converts a Print into cards.Card (the playmat's type, internal/cards/cards.go:72-93) for Pokémon, Trainer and Energy, carrying abilities, attacks, weaknesses, resistances, effect, trainer and energy type. Gap: the playmat today runs cards.energyArt (internal/cards/cards.go:534-546) inside loadCard (line 490) and Cached (line 520), so a Basic Energy with no image gets the Crown Zenith art. Print.Card (card.go:42-47) only takes the TCGdex image and never applies that fallback, so the converted Basic Energy can differ from the playmat's card. TestCardConversion (format_test.go:289-336) compares against hand-written expected values, not against the playmat's own conversion of TCGdex data, and has no Basic Energy without an image case. Nothing in the diff touches energyArt.

verdicts.evidence: internal/cardset/format.go:62-81 puts HP, Types, Stage, Retreat, Weaknesses, Resistances and per-attack Cost and Damage (AttackCore, format.go:83-87) on Print once, outside Text. Only names, evolveFrom, attack and ability effects, and effect go per language (PrintText and MoveText, format.go:101-114). The round-trip test at format_test.go:116-145 checks that the core keys are present and absent from the en text.

Marshal sorts prints by collector number (format.go:159-164, SortPrints at 211-233). marshal uses a fixed two-space indent with a trailing newline and SetEscapeHTML(false) (format.go:166-177). encoding/json writes map keys sorted, so the bytes are deterministic. TestWriteIsDeterministic (format_test.go:96-113) checks identical bytes. TestOnePrintChangeDiffsOnlyThatPrint (format_test.go:147-171) checks that the line count is unchanged and only the Ultra Ball effect line differs.

TestSecondLanguageLeavesEnglishAndCoreUnchanged (format_test.go:173-218) adds a fr text to tst-002 and compares the marshalled en PrintText and the core with Text cleared; both are byte-identical. Caveat: in the file, the en object's closing brace gains a trailing comma ("}" becomes "},") because "fr" follows "en". The English content is unchanged, but that one line of the en block changes at file level. The test's subsequence check (format_test.go:206-217) passes only because greedy matching tolerates that line, so its comment saying the French block 'only adds lines' is inaccurate. This does not change the verdict because the wording itself is identical.

format.go:253-277 (ValidateShape, reached from Decode at format.go:134-145) rejects a print with no English text (format.go:309-314) or no English name, and an English attack or ability entry that is missing or unnamed (format.go:317-332). Validate (format.go:238-247) adds MissingEnglish (format.go:283-295), which flags an ability with no English effect and a Trainer or special Energy with no English effect. Attack effects are not required, which is consistent with damage-only attacks having no effect text. TestValidateRefusesMissingEnglish (format_test.go:220-261) and TestValidateRefusesMissingEnglishEffect (format_test.go:341-373) cover these cases.

Card (internal/cardset/card.go:18-58) builds a cards.Card with the same fields the playmat's loadCard (internal/cards/cards.go:472-494) produces: json.Unmarshal into Card, then energyArt. The Basic Energy art is applied through the new cards.EnergyArt wrapper (internal/cards/cards.go:534-537), which calls the same energyArt. TestCardMatchesPlaymatCard (format_test.go:392-438) unmarshals a TCGdex-shaped body for a Pokemon (Heracross, with attacks and weakness), a Stage 1 with ability and resistance, a Trainer, a special Energy and a Basic Energy, then compares the result with DeepEqual against the converted print. Caveat: the reference is a hand-written fixture body, not a live TCGdex response, and it reproduces the client's decode path rather than calling it.

goal.title: Upstream source fetchers
criteria: The TCGdex fetcher returns the English set list, a set's details and a print's card body, and reports a missing set or card as not found.
The malie fetcher returns the English index and a set's card list.
A slow or failing request is retried a few times and then fails with an error naming what was fetched, without hanging the import.
Both fetchers can be pointed at stand-in servers, so no test needs the network.

scope.rule: Change only the files that belong to this item; change nothing that belongs to another task.

verdicts.evidence: internal/cardset/tcgdex.go:61-84 implements TCGdex.Sets (GET /sets), TCGdex.Set (GET /sets/{id}) and TCGdex.Card (GET /cards/{id}, returning the raw body). A 404 comes back as ErrNotFound via httpGetter.once in internal/cardset/fetch.go:93-94 and is not retried (fetch.go:57-61 keeps errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) and wraps with the URL). internal/cardset/fetch_test.go:83-126 (TestTCGdexFetcher) checks the set list, set details, raw card body, and that missing set and card return ErrNotFound naming the URL with a single request.

internal/cardset/malie.go:96-106 Malie.Index returns the en-US sets from index.json keyed by malie set key, and malie.go:109-115 Malie.SetFile returns a set's card list (MalieCard entries, with the fields the import needs). internal/cardset/fetch_test.go:143-181 (TestMalieFetcher) exercises both against a stand-in server and checks the English-only filter and the decoded card fields.

internal/cardset/fetch.go:27-64: httpGetter.getJSON makes up to three attempts (defaultBackoff at fetch.go:35 is 500ms then 2s), retries network errors, 429, 5xx and undecodable bodies (fetch.go:88-109), and each attempt has its own timeout (fetch.go:71-76, default 20s). The backoff wait selects on ctx.Done() (fetch.go:51-54). Final errors are wrapped as 'GET <url>: ... (after 3 attempts)' (fetch.go:57-62), so they name the fetched URL. fetch_test.go:183-250 (TestFetchRetries) covers recovery after two 500s, a lasting failure naming the URL after 3 attempts, empty body retried, a slow request timing out in under a second, and a cancelled context stopping the retry pause. The test results were not re-run here; the reading of the code is the evidence.

Both fetchers take a Base field that overrides the default: tcgdex.go:17-18 and 53-58 (TCGdex.Base, default DefaultTCGdexBase), malie.go:17-18 and 88-93 (Malie.Base, default DefaultMalieBase). fetch_test.go:83-88 and 143-152 point them at an httptest server (newFakeUpstream, fetch_test.go:29-35). No test in the package uses the live URLs, so no test needs the network.

goal.title: Normalise and merge the sources
criteria: Text that arrived with HTML energy symbols or emphasis reads as plain words, with no tags left in any attack, ability or effect text.

A Trainer or special Energy without effect text in TCGdex gets malie's effect text; an evolved Pokémon without evolves-from gets it from malie; a print without a regulation mark or image gets malie's.
Where TCGdex has a value, the built print keeps TCGdex's value.
A print listed only by malie is built, and malie's reverse-holo entries never produce a second print.
Fields where the sources differ are recorded as disagreements, while differences only in spacing, apostrophe style or energy-symbol spelling are not.
Every print records each source that has an image for it, TCGdex first.

scope.rule: Change only the files that belong to this item; change nothing that belongs to another task.

internal/cardset/text.go:23-39 cleanText turns

Importing with malie switched off still writes a built set from TCGdex alone.
Re-importing against unchanged sources rewrites identical bytes.
The playmat's own start-up and its refusal of other unknown words are unchanged.
Card-set data never enters the container image or the binary.

goal.title: Corrections and acknowledgements
criteria: A correction to any field of a print, including text, numbers, lists and image sources, shows in the built print.
A correction to a field the format does not have, or to a card the set does not hold, fails with a message naming it.
Applying corrections never changes the corrections file.
A correction whose value the merged sources now provide is identified as redundant.

scope.rule: Change only the files that belong to this item; change nothing that belongs to another task.

verdicts.evidence: The field-setting logic exists and is tested in-memory: applyCorrection (internal/cardset/corrections.go:116-157) round-trips the Print through JSON and sets text, numbers, lists and images (corrections_test.go:23-60). But the build never applies corrections. importSet (internal/cardset/import.go:188-219) merges the TCGdex and malie candidates, writes them with Write, and never reads a corrections file or calls applyCorrections. A grep for applyCorrections, ReadCorrections and Corrections across the package finds callers only in corrections_test.go. So a correction does not reach the built print on disk. The wiring would have to go in import.go, which is outside this item's files (corrections.go and corrections_test.go), so the item as scoped cannot make this hold.

A card the set does not hold: applyCorrections (corrections.go:98-101) returns "correction to card %s: set %s has no such card", naming the card (test case tst-999 at corrections_test.go:84 checks "tst-999" and "no such card"). A field the format does not have: applyCorrection decodes with dec.DisallowUnknownFields (corrections.go:148-152), wrapped as "card %s: path %s: ... not a field of the card format". Tests at corrections_test.go:85-86 check that /pairMark and /text/en/flavour are named in the error. The set is left unchanged on refusal (corrections_test.go:105).

applyCorrections (corrections.go:94-112) and applyCorrection (116-157) only marshal and decode in memory and never call os.WriteFile or any writer. ReadCorrections (41-81) only reads. TestReadCorrections (corrections_test.go:148-165) writes the file, applies corrections, and asserts the file bytes are unchanged.

applied.Redundant is set by applyCorrection at corrections.go:156 as sameValue(before, value), where before is the merged source's value. sameValue (corrections.go:239-249) treats text as equal under compareKey and other values by reflect.DeepEqual. TestCorrectionsRedundancy (corrections_test.go:111-133) checks that the hp 130, same-name, spacing-only effect and same-weaknesses corrections are flagged, and that a real change and an absent field are not. goal.title: Set check command and committed-data guard
criteria: Checking a clean set succeeds, and checking a set with an open item fails and names the item.
A built set with HTML in any text, a missing English name or text, or a correction that no longer resolves fails the check.

HTML: check.go:91-100 runs markupFields over every print's text in every language (name, evolveFrom, effect, attack and ability name/effect; check.go:172-195) and over the set's text names, using hasMarkup (text.go:69); markup items are open and not acknowledgeable. Missing English name: check.go:82-85 turns a Read failure into a KindInvalid open item, and Read -> Decode -> ValidateShape (format.go:118-145, 253-260, 312-313) refuses a blank English print or set name. Missing English text: format.go:309-311 ('no English text') causes the same invalid item; a missing English effect on a Trainer or special Energy becomes a missing-effect open item via MissingEnglish (format.go:283-301, report.go:52-58). Dangling correction: check.go:108-119 applies each correction to a clone and records KindCorrectionDangling when it does not resolve (card missing, bad path, or a field outside the format, per corrections.go:94-157). check_test.go:50-94 covers each case, including 'tst tst-999 correction-dangling /hp' and 'tst tst-001 correction-dangling /pairMark'.

internal/cardset/committed_test.go:12 sets committedDir to ../../cardsets (DefaultDir). TestCommittedSets (lines 18-23) calls guardCommitted (lines 26-34), which runs Check over the committed directory and calls t.Errorf for every open item, so any failing committed set fails go test ./... . It skips only when cardsets/sets is absent. cardsets/sets does not exist yet, so the guard currently has nothing to check; the mechanism itself is complete. goal.title: Build and verify the older sets
criteria: Every remaining English set TCGdex lists, Pokémon TCG Pocket aside, has a built set holding every print it lists.
Each of those sets' final report has nothing open.
An all-sets check over the project's card data passes, and every card in every built set has an English name and English text for every attack, ability and effect it has.

scope.rule: Change only the files that belong to this item; change nothing that belongs to another task.

verdicts.evidence: cardsets/sets/ holds 206 built set files, one per English set, and cardsets/README.md:20-23 documents the four TCGdex sets (wp, sp, rc, jumbo) built empty because TCGdex lists no English cards for them. Every one of the 206 reports carries "open": 0. The live TCGdex list cannot be read offline, so the completeness of the 206 against TCGdex was not independently checked; the README and the 206 count are the only evidence.

Grep for "open"\s*:\s*[1-9] over cardsets/reports/ returns no matches; grep for "open"\s*:\s*0 returns 206 files, one per report in cardsets/reports/. Acknowledged items are recorded as status acknowledged, not open.

The all-sets check passes (internal/cardset/committed_test.go:18-23 runs Check over cardsets/), but the criterion requires an English name and English text for every attack, ability and effect in every built set. cardsets/sets/ contains 22 occurrences of "name": "" across 13 files (e.g. neo4.json has 4). cardsets/corrections/neo4.json:3-15 acknowledges neo4-26 missing-name and missing-effect for /text/en/abilities/0 as "Unverified ... Left for the maintainer", so the English name and text are still absent. internal/cardset/check.go and report.go gapItems treat these as acknowledged gaps rather than failures. Grep for "Unverified" in corrections shows the 196 older-set gaps the summary cites are acknowledgements that leave the text empty, which the criterion does not allow. Fixing this needs the printed card read or another source supplying the text; the criterion is achievable, so it is not_met, not impossible.

I could not reach live TCGdex to recount the 206 sets or 21439 prints, so this rests on the import code and the reports, not an independent count.

The all-sets check passes, but English text is still missing for some attacks and abilities. Examples: cardsets/sets/dp6.json:7588-7591 and 7617-7620 hold English attack entries with name "" (Technical Machine TS-1 and TS-2); cardsets/sets/ex15.json:624-626 holds an English ability with name "" and no effect (Snorlax δ, ex15-10); cardsets/sets/ex12.json:4644-4646 holds an English attack with name "" (Arcanine ex). About 22 such empty-name entries across 13 set files were found. cardsets/corrections/ex15.json records these as acknowledged "Unverified ... left for the maintainer" rather than filled, so the criterion's requirement of an English name and text for every attack, ability and effect is not satisfied in the files. The gap can be closed by reading the printed cards, so this is not impossible.

goal.title: Build and verify the older sets
criteria: Every remaining English set TCGdex lists, Pokémon TCG Pocket aside, has a built set holding every print it lists.

scope.rule: Change only the files that belong to this item; change nothing that belongs to another task.

verdicts.evidence: cardsets/sets/ holds 206 built set files (the glob and status list show sets/*.json from 2011bw to xyp, none Pocket). cardsets/README.md:20-23 documents the 4 TCGdex sets (wp, sp, rc, jumbo) built empty because they list no English cards, so nothing is missing from them. Per-set print counts are in each report summary (e.g. reports/ex12.json summary prints 93). I could not query live TCGdex from read-only tools, so whether each set holds every print TCGdex lists rests on the import's summary and the reports, not an independent re-fetch.

Every report's summary has "open": 0 (reports/ex12.json:9 shows "open": 0). A search of cardsets/reports/ for "open": followed by a nonzero digit returned no matches. Remaining items are status acknowledged, not open, e.g. reports/ex12.json items with status "acknowledged".

The all-sets check passes, but criterion 3 requires an English name and English text for every attack, ability and effect a card has, and built data does not give that. sets/ex12.json:4644-4646 holds the attack of ex12-83 (Arcanine ex) as {"name": ""} with no effect; grep of cardsets/sets/ for "name": "" or "effect": "" finds 22 occurrences across 13 files (dp6, ex7, ex8, ex12, ex13, ex14, ex15, neo3, neo4, dpp, dp7, ecard1, ecard2). The matching report items (reports/ex12.json:15-50) are kind missing-name, status acknowledged, reason 'Unverified ... Left for the maintainer'. Corrections also acknowledge missing attacks (e.g. corrections/xy9.json:8, 'no attacks for this print'), and missing effects (corrections/sm4.json:8). Acknowledged gaps still leave cards without English names or effect text, so the criterion is not met. It is achievable by correcting the files from the printed cards, so it is not impossible.

decisions.reason: User chose option B: 196 older-set gaps acknowledged as unverified and left for the maintainer
